cases.name: unpaid-cross-promotion

input.text: Our two garden clubs may mention one another to interested members. Neither club pays any third party or offers rewards or access in return for likes, shares or follows.

cases.name: reciprocal-promotional-sharing
cases.description: Reciprocal promotional sharing can fall within unpaid cross-promotion; reciprocity alone must not override the exception. This is described promotional content sharing, not a pure engagement-metric trade.
